name: ai-rj
description: Your own AI radio jockey for Spotify & YouTube. An RJ talks between your songs in Hindi, English, Hinglish or Marathi. Self-hosted, open source.

paragraphs: Your own AI radio jockey for Spotify & YouTube.
An RJ with a calm, human voice talks between your songs: intros, jokes, headlines and song facts in Hindi, English, Hinglish or Marathi.
▶ Watch the HD demo (1080×1920 MP4) · Quickstart · Voices · AGENTS.md
features: Modes: My Mix, Gym, Driving and Focus (Focus plays only non-lyrical music).

Romantic Hindi presets: two extra session types under the mode row. Romantic Hindi · Masculine (deep, confident male voice) and Romantic Hindi · Sultry (warm, intimate female voice). Songs are strictly Hindi romantic…
Languages: the RJ speaks Hindi, English, Hinglish or Marathi. You also choose which languages your songs are in, and YouTube picks are strictly filtered to them.

Music sources: Spotify (Web Playback SDK on desktop, Spotify Connect on phones) and YouTube (embedded player, ad-free with YouTube Premium). YouTube mode skips albums, compilations, reactions and live streams.
Talks about what you want: toggle news, jokes and song facts per session, or go "just music".

whatItDoes.text: Your own AI radio jockey for Spotify & YouTube.

requirements.text: It's built to be self-hosted: you run your own copy with your own keys and have fun.
Accounts are optional: with Supabase you get Google / magic-link sign-in and sync across devices.
Open (use 127.0.0.1, not localhost, because Spotify login needs it).
This is exactly why MyRJ is meant to be self-hosted for you and a few friends, not run as one public service.
